dedupe_keys.name: us county population weighted daily heat metrics 2000 2020

description: The Heatmetrics research team publishes daily population-weighted heat indicators for counties in the contiguous United States from 2000 to 2020. The repository lists minimum, maximum and mean ambient temperature, dewpoint, humidex, heat index, net effective temperature, wet-bulb globe temperature and UTCI. The RDS file can be loaded with R's readRDS function and is free under CC BY 4.0. It contains modified Copernicus information derived from the ERA5-Land methodology documented by the authors. These county indicators can drive heat-exposure and healthcare-demand simulations or be compared with the broader data-era5-reanalysis source. A caveat is that Monroe County, Florida, and Nantucket County, Massachusetts, are missing because the underlying grids were unavailable. Population weighting represents exposure, not the spatial mean over all land. County aggregation also hides local urban and indoor conditions. The data file was not downloaded.
